name: @limio/ot-onboarding
description: OpenText order-confirmation onboarding: welcome + recap of what was bought (product, ERP, trading partners, data centre), a four-step 'get started' checklist, the day-0-to-9 go-live timeline, and a 'Not sure? Talk to our onboarding assistant' action that opens the Limio onboarding agent (window.LimioChat).

limioProps.label: Kicker
limioProps.default: Order confirmed. Your Trading Grid tenant is being created.

limioProps.label: Headline
limioProps.default: You're in. Let's get you trading in 9 days.

limioProps.label: Subheadline
limioProps.default: We've already started provisioning. Four quick steps and your first purchase order flows straight into your business. Our onboarding assistant can do step 1 with you right now, in about ten minutes.

default.title: Tell us about your setup
default.body: Your ERP version, how you want to connect (AS2, SFTP or VAN) and your EDI ID. No EDI expertise needed: we'll suggest the defaults.

default.title: Invite your team
default.body: Add the people who will manage orders, ASNs and invoices. They get access to the Trading Grid portal as soon as your tenant is live.

default.title: Connect your ERP
default.body: We install your ERP adapter and set up connectivity. If you chose guided onboarding, your B2B specialist books a kickoff call with you.

default.title: Test with your partners, then go live
default.body: We load each partner's maps and run test documents with them. When every partner certifies, your first production order flows.

limioProps.label: Assistant band title
limioProps.default: Not sure where to start? Talk to our onboarding assistant.

limioProps.label: Assistant band body
limioProps.default: It knows your order, explains AS2 vs SFTP in plain English, suggests an EDI ID if you don't have one, and hands everything to your OpenText specialist.

limioProps.label: Fallback link if the assistant is unavailable
